newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada board approves C$897 mln TCPL plan.
newsitem.headline: Canada board approves C$897 mln TCPL plan.

text.p: Canada's National Energy Board said on Thursday it approved TransCanada PipeLines Ltd's revised C$897-million pipeline facilities expansion for 1997/98.
The facilities will enable TCPL to provide new gas transport services totalling 286.7 million cubic feet per day for both domestic and export markets, the NEB said.

The program is set to include construction of 205.5 km of natural gas pipeline looping, 13 compressor units totalling 350 megawatts, three aftercoolers, manifolding and compression-related items on TransCanada's system in Saskatchewan, Manitoba and Ontario.
Construction is slated for 1997, with 138 km of pipeline to be in service in April and the rest in November.
The board's decision follows a public hearing in Winnipeg last month.

The NEB also said it approved an application by Renaissance Energy Ltd for access to TCPL facilities to move 5.1 million cubic feet per day of gas to Emerson, Manitoba from Empress, Alberta starting in September 1997. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
